summary: Replaced the empty src/index.ts stub with a barrel re-export of all 8 Phase A modules (types, colors, help, parser, preflight, runners, screen, raw-mode). The changelog subpath (src/changelog/index.ts) remains its own tsup entry point and is not included in the main barrel to avoid export duplication.
npm run build succeeded: tsup produced dual CJS + ESM output plus .d.ts/.d.cts declaration files for both entry points (dist/index.{js,cjs,d.ts,d.cts} and dist/changelog/index.{js,cjs,d.ts,d.cts}).

Verified runtime resolution: CJS require() and ESM import both enumerate 17 exports from the main entry (C, IS_WIN, NPM, PreflightError, checkNodeVersion, clearScreen, enterRawMode, exitRawMode, isRawModeSupported, log, parseArgs, printHelp, restoreTerminal, runLongScript, runScript, sh, waitForKey) and 4 exports from ./changelog.
npm test: 94 tests across 6 suites passed; coverage 98.9% statements / 90% branches / 100% functions / 100% lines — all thresholds met at >= 80%.

comments.note: src/index.ts now includes screen.ts and raw-mode.ts exports even though those modules are excluded from coverage (they require stdin/TTY mocking). Consider adding a brief comment near their export lines noting they are tested in Phase B, so future maintainers understand the coverage exclusion is intentional.

tsup emits shared type files like dist/types-C-9jodyd.d.cts with a content-hash suffix. This is tsup's default de-duplication strategy for shared type chunks; no action needed, but the unexpected filenames may surprise consumers browsing the dist/ directory. A tsup noExternal or bundle strategy could consolidate them if desired in Phase B.
No observations beyond the above — the Phase A module code across all touched files is clean, consistent, and follows the project's zero-dependency and cross-platform conventions correctly.

summary: All six acceptance criteria verified. Build clean (tsup, dual CJS+ESM, no warnings). Main entry point exports 17 value-level symbols via both CJS require() and ESM import (identical sets confirmed). Changelog subpath exports 4 symbols via both CJS and ESM (no overlap with main). All four .d.ts/.d.cts declaration files present and well-formed (192 and 44 lines respectively). No circular dependencies — dependency direction is strictly one-way: screen→raw-mode, help→types, help→colors, runners→types. TypeScript typecheck passes with zero errors. Full test suite: 94/94 passing across 6 suites; coverage 98.9% stmts / 90% branches / 100% functions / 100% lines — all above the 80% thresholds.

src/index.ts and src/types.ts report 0% coverage in the v8 report. This is expected (barrel re-exports and type-only declarations have no executable lines), but the vitest config could add exclusion globs for these files to keep coverage reporting clean and prevent false alarms for future contributors.

No further observations — barrel export is architecturally sound, entry-point separation is clean (zero symbol overlap between main and ./changelog), and the cross-module dependency graph is acyclic with correct one-way flow.
